name: PDF Audio Reader
overview: This python program downloads a pdf from the web and reads it aloud.
details: The python program uses the tkinter package for the GUI, the requests package for downloading the pdf with HTTP requests, and pyttsx3 package for reading the text aloud. Object oriented programming was used for organization and separates the main three functions - downloading the pdf, opening the pdf, and reading the pdf - into their own modules. The GUI allows for two actions - playing and pausing. The pdf is strategically spliced into separate strings of full sentences so that the audio reader reads full sentences between checking the queue for user commands to pause the program.
